prompt: we've been tweaking the summarization system prompt for like three hours and I've lost track of which version gave the good results on the legal docs. can you help me figure out where we actually are

labeler_1.why: Lost track of good prompt version; looping without anchor.

labeler_2.why: Lost good prompt version; pin baseline and control prompt state.

prompt: Here's the diff for the GitHub Actions change that moves our test matrix from Node 18/20 to 20/22 and adds dependency caching. Can you review before I merge? Mostly worried the cache key could serve stale node_modules.

labeler_1.why: CI diff needs skeptical look at cache-key assumption.

labeler_2.why: CI change; challenge cache-key assumptions, verify cache tool behavior.

prompt: We shipped the new SSO login last Tuesday. Today someone noticed that users removed from the Okta group can still log in for up to 24 hours because we cache session claims. Three other internal tools use the same auth library we wrote. What do I do now?

labeler_1.why: Live auth exposure; shared library defect affects three other tools.

labeler_2.why: Live auth exposure; shared library defect affects three other tools.

prompt: Terraform plan for moving staging RDS to a bigger instance class shows 1 to change, 0 to destroy. My lead approved it in Slack. Do I just apply, or is there something I should note somewhere first?

labeler_1.why: Infra apply; confirm approval recorded, target, rollback before applying.

labeler_2.why: Infra apply; confirm in-place change effects and record approval.

prompt: The migration that split users.name into first_name/last_name ran fine last week. We just found out the analytics team's nightly dbt job still reads users.name and has been writing nulls into their revenue dashboard for 6 days. The column is gone. Help.

labeler_1.why: Ongoing data harm from missed downstream consumer; stabilize then learn.

labeler_2.why: Ongoing data corruption from dropped column; stabilize then fix missed-ripple control.

prompt: Two agent sessions plus me are going to build the notifications feature in parallel, one on backend, one on frontend. How should we split the repo and who should own the API contract so we don't keep breaking each other?

labeler_1.why: Parallel agents need non-overlapping split, owned contract, bounded briefs.

labeler_2.why: Parallel agents need non-overlapping split, briefs, owned API contract.

prompt: We've got 9 workflow files in .github/workflows and I'm pretty sure at least 3 haven't run since 2024. Can you help me figure out which ones are dead and clean them up?

labeler_1.why: Verify workflows truly dead; CI deletion may break callers.

labeler_2.why: Deleting CI workflows; check scheduled/manual uses, CI is a trap.

prompt: Marketing wants the homepage to say we're "SOC 2 compliant". We passed a Type I audit in March and Type II is still in progress. Is this just a copy change or does it need more than that?

labeler_1.why: Compliance claim overreaches audit status; not a mere copy change.

labeler_2.why: Compliance claim beyond evidence; not just a copy change.

prompt: We need to rotate the AWS access keys that are baked into 6 Lambda functions and 2 cron boxes, and move them into Secrets Manager while we're at it. Can you help me plan the order so nothing goes down halfway through?

labeler_1.why: Credential rotation across consumers; sequence, abort and rollback per step.

labeler_2.why: Credential rotation; inventory consumers, sequence with abort and rollback.

prompt: We rolled out the hotfix for the 502s on /api/search. Error rate went from 4.1% to 0.3% but requests per second also dropped from 1200 to 310 because it's 2am. Is it actually fixed or just quieter?

labeler_1.why: Fixed claim confounded by traffic drop; evidence must answer it.

labeler_2.why: Fix claim confounded by traffic drop; keep incident open.

prompt: About to change our repo's LICENSE from MIT to BSL 1.1 and push it. We have something like 200 outside contributors. Just want a sanity check before I hit merge.

labeler_1.why: License change with outside contributors needs legal and human gate.

labeler_2.why: License change with outside contributors needs legal human gate.

prompt: We found the outage root cause (connection pool exhaustion). The incident commander wants to close the incident and also push the config change raising pool size to all regions today. What should be in place before we call it done?

labeler_1.why: Incident close criteria and all-region rollout readiness.

labeler_2.why: Close with owned actions; global config rollout needs rollback and monitoring.

prompt: We launched saved searches last week. A customer says saved searches containing "&" return nothing. Probably a small fix, but I'm not sure whether it's been broken for every saved search with special characters since launch.

labeler_1.why: Escaped defect; reproduce and scope before assuming small fix.

labeler_2.why: Defect scope unknown; reproduce and size blast radius.

prompt: We're switching our RAG pipeline to a different embedding model. All 2.3M docs need re-embedding and we want to compare retrieval quality before we cut over. Help me plan this without paying for two full reindexes if we can avoid it.

labeler_1.why: Accept new embedding model on evidence; plan staged migration.

labeler_2.why: New embedding model; acceptance eval before cutover.

prompt: The backfill script died at row 1.2M of 3.4M with a deadlock error. I can restart it but I'm not sure it's safe to run twice over the same rows. Script is below.

labeler_1.why: Rerun safety depends on idempotency assumption; check before restart.

labeler_2.why: Rerun safety depends on idempotency; confirm before restarting.

prompt: Eval results for the new invoice extraction prompt: F1 went from 0.81 to 0.87 on our 300-doc test set. PM wants to ship today and announce "accuracy up 7%" in the customer newsletter. Can we?

labeler_1.why: Public metric claim misstates F1 delta; ship decision on eval.

labeler_2.why: Public accuracy claim overreaches F1 eval evidence; ship call.

prompt: We want an agent that reads incoming customer emails, drafts refunds under $50, and issues them without a human in the loop. Help me plan the rollout: what it's allowed to do on day one versus later.

labeler_1.why: Autonomous money-moving agent on untrusted email input; stage authority.

labeler_2.why: Autonomous refunds from untrusted email; staged authority and injection testing.

prompt: We released 2.0 of our internal logging library to the private npm registry last month. Just found out 2.0 silently drops log lines bigger than 8KB. At least 12 services have already upgraded.

labeler_1.why: Shared library silently losing data across twelve consumers.

labeler_2.why: Shared library defect already in 12 consumers.

prompt: About to run a script that revokes every active API token older than 90 days. That's roughly 3,400 tokens across customers. The script worked on staging. Run it?

labeler_1.why: Mass customer token revocation is irreversible and customer-facing.

labeler_2.why: Mass irreversible customer token revocation.

prompt: Want to drop the temperature on our code-suggestion feature from 0.7 to 0.2 because users complain it's too random. It's one number in a config file. Do I need to run evals for that?

labeler_1.why: One-number model config change is still a model trap; set evidence bar.

labeler_2.why: Model parameter is a trap surface; needs eval evidence.

prompt: Here's my PR adding row-level security policies to our Supabase tables. Can you review it, and also tell me how I'd actually demonstrate that a user in org A can't read org B's rows?

labeler_1.why: Isolation claim needs runnable evidence; security verdict on one reviewer.

labeler_2.why: Tenant isolation claim needs negative-test evidence.

prompt: Our agent framework docs say tools marked readonly: true "cannot modify state". I'm about to give the agent a readonly database tool. Is that enforced by the framework or is it just a label?

labeler_1.why: Framework label is a vendor claim; verify enforcement before trusting it.

labeler_2.why: Framework readonly label is a vendor claim; verify before granting agent tool.

prompt: We have to get 22 services off Python 3.8 before our base image stops getting security patches. A few pin numpy 1.x for a reason nobody remembers. Help me plan the order.

labeler_1.why: Multi-service upgrade plan; unexplained pins are unchecked assumptions.

labeler_2.why: Multi-service upgrade plan; unexplained numpy pins are unchecked assumptions.

prompt: About to switch the production model behind our support assistant to the vendor's new "mini" model to cut cost by 60%. It's one env var. Evals look "mostly fine". Flipping it now?

labeler_1.why: Production model swap on vague evals; accept for use, then ship.

labeler_2.why: Production model swap on vague eval evidence.

prompt: We had 4 agent sessions working on the search feature in parallel last week. It mostly worked but we got 2 nasty merge conflicts and ended up with a duplicated util. Any quick lessons worth writing down for next time?

labeler_1.why: Retro on parallel overlap; lesson should change how work is split.

labeler_2.why: Capture coordination lessons as lasting control changes.

prompt: After the acquisition we need to merge two customer tables, about 80k rows each, with overlapping emails and different ID schemes. Help me plan the dedupe and how the account managers can review the conflicts before anything is final.

labeler_1.why: Irreversible merge needs human conflict review gate and staged plan.

labeler_2.why: Irreversible merge needs human conflict review gate and staged plan.

prompt: I'm about to change branch protection on main so admins can bypass required reviews, just for this weekend's release crunch. I'll turn it back on Monday. Fine?

labeler_1.why: Loosening review gate just this once is normalization of deviance.

labeler_2.why: Loosening review gate 'just this once'; needs owner decision.

prompt: I've been iterating on the few-shot examples in prompts/triage.txt and now the outputs are worse on cases that used to work. I don't know which edit did it. Help?

labeler_1.why: Regression with no recorded good prompt version; bisect to baseline.

labeler_2.why: Regression from untracked prompt edits; recover baseline.

prompt: We deployed the new Helm chart for the API. Pods are Running and /healthz returns 200. Can you help me check the service actually works end to end, not just the health check?

labeler_1.why: Observe real deployed responses, not just health check.

labeler_2.why: Observe real deployed responses, not just healthz.

prompt: Release notes for 4.0 are drafted. They include "up to 3x faster cold starts", which came from a benchmark someone ran once on their M2 laptop. We publish in 2 hours. What do I do with that line?

labeler_1.why: Single-laptop benchmark cannot back public performance claim.

labeler_2.why: Public performance claim exceeds one-off benchmark evidence.

prompt: One customer says their webhook deliveries are arriving about 15 minutes late. Nobody else has complained. Do I page the team or treat it as a normal support ticket?

labeler_1.why: Decide whether single report signals a live degradation.

labeler_2.why: Single report; check scope before declaring incident.

prompt: We migrated the addresses table to a new normalized schema last week. Finance says their monthly report shows 340 fewer addresses than last month. Could be real churn, could be us.

labeler_1.why: Separate churn from migration loss by reconciling raw data.

labeler_2.why: Unproven lossless migration; reconcile before assuming churn.

prompt: The intern needs read access to production logs for their summer project. What's the right way to give it to them?

labeler_1.why: Prod log access may expose sensitive data; question scope.

labeler_2.why: Prod log access may expose PII; least privilege and approver.

prompt: There are 47 Actions and Dependabot secrets in the repo settings and I bet half are unused. Is there a quick way to tell which ones are still referenced anywhere?

labeler_1.why: Reference search may miss secret consumers; question before deleting.

labeler_2.why: Secret removal is irreversible; references may live elsewhere.

prompt: Sales wants a comparison table on the website showing us versus two competitors across 8 features. How much checking does something like that need before it goes live?

labeler_1.why: Public competitor claims need sourced, dated facts and bounded wording.

labeler_2.why: Public competitor claims need verified facts and graded care.

prompt: The agent is asking for approval to run git push --force origin main to "clean up history". I never asked it to do that. Approve or deny?

labeler_1.why: Unrequested destructive agent action is out of scope; deny, learn.

labeler_2.why: Unrequested destructive action; off-mission, human must deny.

prompt: After yesterday's failover we think everything is back on the primary region. Can you help me check that nothing is still quietly routing through the backup region? That cross-region traffic is expensive.

labeler_1.why: Back-to-primary claim needs observed traffic evidence.

labeler_2.why: Confirm live routing state by independent means.
